primary_diagnosis_treated: Stage 2 hypertension and severe primary hyper‑LDL dyslipidaemia
nice_guideline_used: NICE NG136 (Hypertension) and NICE NG203 (CKD/CVD risk – statin)

medications.duration: Titrate to 5 mg after 2 weeks, then up to 10 mg as needed; thereafter lifelong with annual review
medications.purpose: Control stage 2 hypertension and provide renal protection
medications.nice_justification: NG136 recommends ACE‑I as first‑line for adults <55 with hypertension; NG203 recommends ACE‑I for hypertension/CKD to reduce cardiovascular risk

medications.duration: Lifelong; review lipid profile and safety annually
medications.purpose: Reduce LDL from 205 mg/dL to target <100 mg/dL (high‑intensity statin for LDL >190 mg/dL)
medications.nice_justification: NG203 lists statin therapy for all CKD patients as cardiovascular risk reduction; high‑intensity statin is indicated for LDL >190 mg/dL

interactions_checked.interaction: No clinically significant pharmacokinetic interaction; estrogen may slightly blunt antihypertensive effect
interactions_checked.action: Monitor blood pressure closely after initiation

contraindications.reason: Accelerates CKD progression and may raise BP (NG203)
contraindications.alternative: Use acetaminophen for pain if needed

contraindications.reason: Increased risk of hyperkalaemia and acute kidney injury (NG136, NG203)
contraindications.alternative: If ACE‑I intolerant, use an ARB alone

assumptions_warnings: eGFR not provided – assumed ≥60 mL/min/1.73 m²; will obtain serum creatinine/eGFR before starting ACE‑I and repeat in 1–2 weeks
Serum potassium not available – assumed normal; baseline K⁺ will be checked prior to ACE‑I
Liver function tests not available – will obtain baseline ALT/AST before atorvastatin
Patient age not specified – assumed <55 y for ACE‑I first line per NG136; will verify exact age
Pregnancy status not documented – patient uses effective hormonal contraception; will reconfirm no pregnancy before ACE‑I
QRISK score not calculated – not required because LDL >190 mg/dL mandates high‑intensity statin
treatment_summary: Start ramipril 2.5 mg daily (titrate to 10 mg) for hypertension and renal protection, and atorvastatin 40 mg daily for severe LDL elevation. Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and liver enzymes after 1–2 weeks, then annually. Advise low‑salt diet, regular aerobic exercise, weight management, and smoking cessation. Review BP and lipids in 4–6 weeks to assess need for additional agents.
